description: This Java class 'ObjectMapperFactory' provides methods to create and configure Jackson ObjectMapper and ObjectWriter instances with custom serializers and deserializers for JSON processing within the MockServer project.

classes.name: ObjectMapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and configuring Jackson ObjectMapper and ObjectWriter instances with custom serializers and deserializers for JSON processing in the MockServer project.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton ObjectMapper, optionally with additional serializers.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton ObjectMapper with additional serializers.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton ObjectMapper with replacement deserializers.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates an ObjectWriter with options for pretty printing and default value serialization, with optional additional serializers.

methods.name: buildObjectMapperWithoutRemovingEmptyValues
methods.description: Builds an ObjectMapper configured to ignore unknown properties, nulls, empty beans, and with relaxed parsing features.

methods.name: buildObjectMapperWithOnlyConfigurationDefaults
methods.description: Builds an ObjectMapper with default configuration and support for Java time serialization.

methods.name: buildObjectMapperWithDeserializerAndSerializers
methods.description: Builds an ObjectMapper with specified deserializers and serializers, and default configuration.

methods.name: addDeserializers
methods.description: Adds a set of deserializers to a Jackson SimpleModule, overriding existing ones if necessary.

methods.name: addSerializers
methods.description: Adds a set of serializers to a Jackson SimpleModule, overriding existing ones if necessary.
